query:
UPDATE budget_allocations
        SET category = ?1,
            amount_minor_units = ?2,
            period_start_unix = ?3,
            period_end_unix = ?4,
            updated_at_unix = ?5,
            revision = revision + 1
        WHERE id = ?6 AND user_id = ?7 AND revision = ?8
        RETURNING id AS "id!"
